prompt:
Mobile app screen, portrait, shot straight on, filling the frame edge to edge — no phone mockup, no environment. This is the UI itself.

The interface is the standard modern running app, executed impeccably — the category default at full craft. Near-black ground (#0B0B0F), off-white type (#F5F5F7), a vivid orange accent (#FF5A1F), a green success accent (#22C55E).

Structure:
- Header with a small avatar circle, "Hola, Fernando" and a settings glyph.
- A large rounded card with a subtle dark-on-dark gradient: "HOY" label, "Tirada larga", then the metric "18" enormous with "km" beside it in orange, and beneath it a row of three small stat blocks — pace, zone, duration — separated by thin dividers.
- A circular progress ring assembly below: one large ring at 62% in orange with a smaller concentric green ring, the number "7/16" centred inside, labelled "Semana".
- A horizontal bar chart of the last seven days in orange bars with rounded caps.
- A prominent orange pill button, full width, rounded, reading "Empezar entrenamiento".
- A bottom tab bar with five glyph icons, the active one orange.

Typography: a geometric sans throughout, generous rounded corners on every surface, soft shadows, subtle gradients. Spanish language UI. Polished, energetic, and completely conventional for its category.
